Tomas is checking the northern trail.
Suri is checking the river trail.
Birch Watch has enough lamp oil.
We will report again after sunset.

main_story.headline: Scouting Operations and Supply Verification at Birch Watch
main_story.lede: Personnel arrived at the Birch Watch location to conduct a systematic survey of nearby trails while confirming necessary supplies for continued operation.
main_story.body:
**Suri** and **Tomas** successfully reached *Birch Watch*. Upon arrival, **Roan** confirmed that the site is currently stocked with enough lamp oil to support local activities.

The pair then coordinated a split assessment of the surrounding geography. **Tomas** began an inspection of the *northern trail* while **Suri** moved to evaluate the *river trail*. The group has established that further reports will be provided following sunset.
